name: mutaci
description: MutaCI — PR-scoped mutation testing. Detects behavioral gaps that line coverage misses. Runs Stryker on the changed files, classifies each surviving mutant via Laya AI (severity score 1-10), then generates targeted tests via Claude.

pr_description.description: Human-readable description of the PR to analyse (e.g. 'Add seasonal discount to cart checkout').

project.description: Path to the TypeScript/Jest project to mutate. Defaults to demo-app/.

demo.description: Run with pre-recorded demo data instead of a live Stryker run.

anthropic_api_key.description: Anthropic API key for Claude test generation. Omit to skip test generation.

surviving_mutants.description: Number of surviving mutants (untested behavioural gaps).

severity_scores.description: Laya severity scores (1-10) for each surviving mutant.

generated_tests.description: Paths to generated test files (written by Claude).

examples.title: Demo run on demo-app

input.pr_description: Add seasonal discount pricing to cart

examples.description: Finds 4 behavioral gaps in pricing.ts in ~5 seconds using pre-recorded Stryker output.

examples.title: Live run on class-validator
examples.description: Full Stryker run — takes 5-15 min. Requires: cd real-target-jest && npm install.
